title: Don't Politicise Ayodhya Ram Temple Donation Theft, Cautions Supreme Court
description: The Supreme Court on Monday observed that the Ayodhya Ram Mandir donation theft issue should not be politicised. Hearing petitions seeking CBI investigation and audit of the temple trust finances, Chief Justice of India Surya Kant said, “It is a simple case of commission of offense...we are cautioning - do not politicize this issue", the CJI said.
